column4: Scan with WAiNK. The game does not show which individual posters you already scanned. The single red poster unlocks the playlist under Radio > The Vault. NW 6th St. PowerPyx describes the entrance poster; GTA6GPS also reports posters near side reception, behind the DJ booth in the left hallway, and upstairs before the club entrance. If the entrance poster is absent, check those alternatives. The upstairs map is https://gta6gps.com/?p=pin-917127. Check Radio for the unlock; only one playlist completion is tracked.
